title: Feature Request: Record Test & Injection Site Info
body:
Hello,

What would it take to be able to record the physical location of finger blood glucose test and insulin injection sites?

The app Diabetes:M has this feature but doesn't have the other functions I require.

Their implementation uses coloured markers on a chart of the body and hands. These markers fade over time allowing you to avoid recently used sites.

I find that this feature helps me to rotate injection and test sites.

Thanks

![Screenshot_20200406-121509__02__01](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62962850/78554420-09a0f580-7803-11ea-983c-813f520a37df.jpg)

comments.body:
That is fantastic tool.
Why do you want it to be a part of the CGM app though?
The CGM app is already quite complicated.  Let's not make it any more complicated than it needs to be.  
Let's just make sure it does what it needs to do well instead of spreading ourselves too thin.
